summary: iter95bd backend wyceny full coverage: price_min/max (set & clearable), price_change_history (multi-edit, below_min flag), cena rounding via _build_wycena_export, export.xlsx, smoke (list/scope-templates/position/stage). 12/12 backend tests PASS. Frontend UI partial — notification dialog overlay blocked deeper interactive flow, but SubRow/PosRow code statically verified (data-testid, Math.round, ring-2 ring-[#DC2626], Radix Popover wiring) and no JS errors observed.

minor.issue: FastAPI Query uses deprecated `regex=` instead of `pattern=` (DeprecationWarning at lines 1484 & 1835 in routes/wyceny.py). Non-blocking but should be migrated to pattern= for forward compatibility.

integration_issues.issue: A 'Włącz powiadomienia' (browser notifications) modal dialog overlays the admin dashboard on load and intercepts pointer events. Wyceny tab click via force=True didn't switch the active TabsContent (background still shows Magazyn/Sprzęt content). Test must close the notification modal before interacting with other tabs. This is not a regression of iter95bd changes but it does prevent automated UI smoke from reaching the Wyceny screen.

action_items: (Optional) Migrate FastAPI Query `regex=` → `pattern=` in /app/backend/routes/wyceny.py lines 1484 and 1835 to silence DeprecationWarning.

(Optional) Add a dismiss-by-test-id button on the notification permission modal OR auto-dismiss after navigation, so UI automation can reach other admin tabs without manual close. Currently the modal blocks interaction with the admin dashboard area behind it.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/wyceny.py is 2732 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into modules (e.g. wyceny_lines.py, wyceny_export.py, wyceny_templates.py).
SubRow.js (357 lines) — acceptable size; Popover, belowMin/aboveMax logic, history list and data-testid attributes are clean.

PosRow.js line 112 uses Math.round(row.cena) but doesn't preserve PL number formatting for very large values (e.g. 1234567 → '1234567' vs fmtPLN '1 234 567'). Consider using fmtPLN with 0 fraction digits, e.g. `row.cena ? new Intl.NumberFormat('pl-PL',{maximumFractionDigits:0}).format(row.cena) : '—'` for visual consistency with neighbouring cells (kaucjaGir, kosztPrognozowany use fmtPLN with separators).
_build_wycena_export returns both `cena` (rounded) and `cena_unrounded`. Xlsx generator should pick one explicitly — current behaviour confirmed correct via unit test.
